mapper.insert: INSERT INTO clubs (name, slug, alias_name, description, category, meeting_schedule, schedule_note, location, contact_email, advisor, image_url, achievements, status, visibility, approved_at, approved_by_oauth_user_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{slug}, #{aliasName}, #{description}, #{category}, #{meetingSchedule}, #{scheduleNote}, #{location}, #{contactEmail}, #{advisor}, #{imageUrl}, #{achievements, typeHandler=com.example.demo.club.mapper.AchievementsTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{visibility}, #{approvedAt}, #{approvedByOauthUserId})

mapper.select: SELECT cm.role_name, ou.email, TRUE AS member FROM club_member cm JOIN oauth_users ou ON ou.uid = cm.oauth_user_id WHERE cm.club_id = #{clubId} AND LOWER(ou.email) = LOWER(#{email}) LIMIT 1

SELECT cm.oauth_user_id, ou.display_name, ou.email, ou.avatar_url, cm.role_name, cm.joined_at FROM club_member cm JOIN oauth_users ou ON ou.uid = cm.oauth_user_id WHERE cm.club_id = #{clubId} ORDER BY cm.joined_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO club_member (club_id, oauth_user_id, role_name) VALUES (#{clubId}, #{oauthUserId}, #{roleName}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role_name = VALUES(role_name)

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.alias_name, c.description, c.category, c.meeting_schedule, c.schedule_note, c.location, c.contact_email, c.advisor, c.image_url, (SELECT link_url FROM club_social_medias WHERE club_id = c.id AND social_type = 'instagram' LIMIT 1) AS instagram_url, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM club_member WHERE club_id = c.id) AS member_count, c.achievements, c.status, c.visibility, c.approved_at, c.approved_by_oauth_user_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at FROM clubs c JOIN club_member cm ON cm.club_id = c.id WHERE cm.oauth_user_id = #{oauthUserId} AND c.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.name ASC
